subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` agent avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain unsupported for Control UI and be documented or validated that way?
rationale: The remaining change affects CSP, browser network fetching, privacy expectations, authenticated avatar reads, and the public avatar configuration contract, so automation should not silently choose the policy.

options.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
options.body: Preserve the merged CSP posture and align CLI help, docs, validation, and diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Build a same-origin remote-avatar proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned proxy or cache with explicit MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and network rules.

options.title: Allow direct remote image fetches
options.body: Let the browser load arbitrary remote avatar URLs directly, accepting the CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve the merged CSP posture and align CLI help, docs, validation, and diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across original avatar support, avatar safety hardening, and Control UI security policy.
